items.item_text: Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Able to flex work hours and locations, including overtime, weekends, and holidays if required for business needs.

Minimum of four (4) years related experience in a healthcare setting, with extensive knowledge of administrative practices including using electronic health record (EHR) systems (EPIC) for scheduling, patient records, and billing.
Previous experience as an administrative lead, effectively overseeing and managing front office administration.
Experience developing standard work, including process standardization, quality improvement, training, and collaboration.
Experience with time-keeping and managing staff schedules.
Experience in Artera or similar patient communication tools.

Under the supervision of the Practice Manager, the Patient Service Representative Lead primarily oversees and provides leadership and training for all front-end duties such as reception, call center, referral and authorizations and other advanced administrative duties such as templates, office purchases, coaching, etc. The Patient Service Representative Lead has oversight over junior counterparts. The Patient Service Representative Lead serves as a resource for the entire department. With the guidance of the Clinic Manager, the Patient Service Representative Lead initiates and participates in improvement efforts which directly impact the practice. Performs other related duties as assigned.
Possess the skills, and extensive knowledge of practices in an Ambulatory setting.
